cards.name: Zone Eater
cards.officialTextJa: 「ゾーン・イーター」の攻撃を受けたモンスターは、５ターン後に破壊される。
cards.officialRuling: The attack turn is turn 1; count both players' turns; destroy during the End Phase of turn 5; no chain block is created by the destruction processing.

cards.name: Swordsman from a Distant Land
cards.officialTextJa: 「異国の剣士」の攻撃を受けたモンスターは、５ターン後に破壊される。
cards.officialRuling: The attack turn is turn 1; count both players' turns; destroy during the End Phase of turn 5; no chain block is created by the destruction processing.

cards.name: Steel Scorpion
cards.officialText: A non-Machine monster attacking Steel Scorpion is destroyed at the End Phase of its opponent's 2nd turn after the attack.
cards.officialRuling: The attack turn is the opponent's first counted turn; count only the opponent's turns; destroy at the End Phase of the opponent's third turn; the effect triggers after damage calculation even if Steel Scorpion is destroyed by battle; no chain block is created by the destruction processing.
cards.eligibilityBasis: Official Konami OCG database date, not the conflicting archive firstObserved date

turnCountingModes.Zone Eater and Swordsman from a Distant: attack turn is turn 1; count both players' turns; fifth turn End Phase
turnCountingModes.Steel Scorpion: attack turn is opponent's first counted turn; count opponent turns only; opponent's third turn End Phase

implementationNotes: The event is captured after damage calculation from the attack snapshot; the source monster does not need to remain on the field.
The delayed target is tracked by physical UID and epoch. Leaving and re-entering the field creates a different instance and prevents stale destruction.
Control may change before the due End Phase; if the same physical card remains in the Monster Zone, it is still destroyed.
The destination Graveyard follows the physical owner's team, not the controller at resolution.
Steel Scorpion's historical archive firstObserved date conflicts with Konami's OCG database. The official 2002-10-24 date is used for cutoff eligibility.
scope: Isolated delayed battle-destruction primitive, tests, official evidence and focused workflow only. No card registry, catalog, certification, Discord handler or persistent duel-state integration.
certificationGate: Do not certify until integrated into the live battle/End Phase resolver and validated in complete 2v2 matches.
